ENFORCEMENT_SCOPE: Aggregate scheduling bandwidth within service cgroup; not terminal total CPU-seconds budget
PERMISSION_REQUIREMENTS: Manager property application, actual cpu+cpuacct membership and readable kernel accounting; unverified
QUOTA_OR_WEIGHT: Quota candidate; shares/weight alone are not finite ceiling
TOTAL_TIME_GAP: If mandatory, separately qualified controller enforces monitored cpuacct threshold with bounded overshoot or a conservative quota-times-hard-lifetime envelope including periods and stop/finalization; no exact justified values or bound supplied. Quota alone is rejected.
